fields.title: Shipping
fields.body:
## Where we ship

We ship to the countries you can choose at checkout. The shipping cost for your country is shown at checkout, before you pay.

## When your order leaves

We send your order within 【fill in: number】 working days after payment, from 【fill in: the city and country you ship from】.

## Delivery times

Delivery usually takes the time shown at checkout for your country. It can take longer at busy times, or when customs inspect a parcel.

## Tracking

When your order ships, we email you its tracking number.

## Customs, duties and taxes

An order shipped across a border may be charged import duties or taxes by your country. 【fill in: who pays them, for example "They are not included in our prices: the carrier collects them from you on delivery."】

## Lost or damaged parcels

If your parcel has not arrived within 【fill in: number】 days, or arrives damaged, write to {{contact_email}} with your order number (it starts with ORD-) and a photo, and we will sort it out.

fields.title: Returns & warranty
fields.body:
## Returns

You can return an item within 【fill in: number of days, for example 14 or 30】 days after you receive it, 【fill in: in what condition, for example "unused and in its original packaging"】.

To start a return, write to {{contact_email}} with your order number. Please do not send anything back before we have replied with the return address.

【fill in: who pays for the return shipping】

## Refunds

We refund to the way you paid (PayPal) within 【fill in: number】 days after the return arrives. PayPal sends you a confirmation when the refund is made.

## Damaged or wrong items

If an item arrives damaged, or is not what you ordered, write to us within 【fill in: number】 days with your order number and a photo. We send a replacement or refund it, shipping included.

## Warranty

【fill in: your warranty, for example "Our products have a 12-month warranty against manufacturing defects."】 A product page may name its own warranty; that one applies to that product.

Your rights as a consumer under the law of your country are not affected.

fields.title: Privacy
fields.body:
This page explains what {{store_name}} does with your personal data when you order from this shop.

## What we collect

When you order, we collect your name, email address, phone number and delivery address, what you ordered, and your note if you write one. We use them to deliver your order, to email you about it and to answer your questions.

## Payments

Payments are made with PayPal. We never see or store your card or bank details. PayPal tells us that you paid, the amount, and the email address of your PayPal account. PayPal's own privacy statement covers what you give PayPal.

## Who else sees your data

- PayPal, to take the payment.
- The carrier that delivers your parcel: your name, address and phone number.
- Our email provider, which sends the order emails.
- Busabase, the workspace software where we keep our order records.

We do not sell your data and do not use it for advertising.

## How long we keep it

【fill in: for example "We keep order records as long as tax law requires, usually 【number】 years."】

## Cookies

This shop sets no cookies of its own and does no tracking. It keeps your basket in your own browser until you order. On the payment page, PayPal's button may set PayPal's own cookies.

## Your rights

You can ask us what data we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it where the law allows. Write to {{contact_email}}.

## Who we are

【fill in: your business name and address】

fields.title: Terms
fields.body:
These terms apply to orders placed on this website, which is run by 【fill in: your business name, address and, if you have one, company registration number】.

## Orders and prices

Prices are shown in the shop's currency and 【fill in: "include all taxes" or "do not include the import duties and taxes of your country"】. Shipping is added at checkout, before you pay. Your order is accepted when the payment is complete and we email you a confirmation.

## Payment

You pay with PayPal when you order (or, for an order request, after we have confirmed it by email). If an item turns out to be unavailable after you paid, we tell you by email and refund it in full.

## Delivery

See our [Shipping](/pages/shipping) page.

## Returns and warranty

See our [Returns & warranty](/pages/returns) page.

## Law
